stemMd: What is the passage mainly concerned with?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Arguing that mobile applications cannot collect useful data

options.label: B
options.textMd: Proving all moth populations are declining

options.label: C
options.textMd: Distinguishing changes in reported sightings from changes in wildlife abundance

options.label: D
options.textMd: Replacing volunteers with only paid observers

options.label: E
options.textMd: Showing that towns contain no moths

explanationMd: The app changes participation, which can change report counts independently of abundance. The scientists try to separate those influences rather than accept or reject the data wholesale.

distractorRationale.e: Town recruitment is mentioned without that claim.
distractorRationale.a: The scientists retain and adjust the records.
